newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel diamond exports up 7 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Israel diamond exports up 7 pct in January.

text.p: Israel's net exports of polished diamonds rose seven percent in January from a year earlier to $427 million, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Sunday.
The increase snapped a two-month decline in diamond exports.
Tsafrir Anbar, the head of the diamond unit at the ministry, said January figures were usually high as retailers re-stock after Christmas sales.

The ministry said exports to the United States, Israel's main market, reached $202 million in January. Exports of uncut or paritally cut diamonds rose 20 percent from a year earlier to $96 million, the ministry said.
Israeli net diamond exports rose last year by four percent over 1995.
